operating_notes.text: Lupin launched dapagliflozin and metformin hydrochloride ER tablets in four strengths (5/500, 5/1000, 10/500, 10/1000 mg) in the US after FDA approval of its ANDA as bioequivalent to Xigduo XR.
Lupin received US FDA approval for Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid, 1.1 grams per mL, referencing Ravicti with USD 337 million sales in MAT Dec 2025.
Acquired 100% share capital of VISUfarma B.V., Netherlands through Nanomi B.V. on April 01, 2026 for EUR 192.8 million.
Q4FY26 US sales were USD 371 Mn (₹3,399 Cr), 46% of global sales; FY26 US sales USD 1,318 Mn, 42% of global sales.
Lupin had 151 generic products in the US, 52 First-to-File filings (22 exclusive) and 430 cumulative ANDA filings with 344 approvals as of March 31, 2026.
Operating working capital was ₹7,132 Cr at quarter end with operating days at 87.
Received US FDA approval for Famotidine Injection USP, 20 mg/2 mL, with USD 8.7 million in annual U.S. sales.
FY26 US sales reached USD 1,318 million, up 40% YoY.
Received US FDA tentative approval for Revefenacin Inhalation Solution, 175 mcg/3 mL, referencing Yupelri with USD 260.7 million in annual U.S. sales.
Received China NMPA approval for Oseltamivir Phosphate oral suspension (6 mg/mL), marking Lupin's first product entry into China in partnership with Yabao Pharmaceuticals.
Announced Phase 1a trial data for LNP8701 (SOS1 inhibitor) at ASCO 2026, showing a favorable safety profile and stable disease in patients.
Received US FDA approval for Sodium Sulfate, Magnesium Sulfate, and Potassium Chloride Tablets as exclusive first-to-file with 180-day exclusivity.
Lupin and Natco received US FDA approval for Eribulin Mesylate Injection (USD 43.7 million annual U.S. market per IQVIA MAT April 2026).
Received U.S. FDA approval for Ranluspec (ranibizumab-hkdz) as an interchangeable biosimilar referencing Lucentis.
Partnered with Laboratorios ERN to launch Luforbec (beclometasone/formoterol 100/6) pMDI in Spain, expanding European rollout following UK and Germany.
US respiratory products (Tiotropium, Albuterol, Xopenex) are over 20% of the US base business; Albuterol share has stabilised at 16% and Tiotropium at about 38%.
India chronic segment is around 67% of the portfolio, up from around 65% in FY26, with a target of 70% in five years; in-licensed products are around 6% of India sales.
Adjacencies (Diagnostics, Digital, OTC, CDMO) are loss-making and cost about 1%-1.5% of EBITDA margin; Diagnostics is expected to break even next year.

timeline.summary: On 22 April 2026 Lupin launched dapagliflozin and metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets in the US after FDA approval of its ANDA as bioequivalent to Xigduo XR.
Lupin Limited schedules Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 08, 2026, at 16:00 hrs (IST) via Zoom.
Lupin promoter Manju D. Gupta declared zero share encumbrance for FY2025-26 with total promoter holding at 46.86%.
Lupin received US FDA approval for Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid on May 5, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,474.66 Cr (+31.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,460.34 Cr (+89.0% YoY).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,392 Cr (+32.9% YoY), PAT ₹1,469 Cr (+87.7% YoY), US sales ₹3,399 Cr (+56.9%); board recommended 900% dividend.
On May 13, 2026, Lupin announced US FDA approval for Famotidine Injection USP, manufactured at its Nagpur facility.
On May 8, 2026, Lupin reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹7,475 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹27,958 Cr with a net profit of ₹1,460 Cr for the quarter.
Lupin received US FDA tentative approval for Revefenacin Inhalation Solution on May 18, 2026.
On May 19, 2026, Lupin announced its debut inclusion in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class World and Emerging Markets Indices 2026.
On May 22, 2026, Lupin announced receipt of China NMPA approval for Oseltamivir Phosphate oral suspension, marking its debut in the Chinese market.
Lupin received the US FDA Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) for its Ankleshwar facility.
Lupin shared Phase 1 data on its novel SOS1 inhibitor LNP8701 at the ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting.
On May 29, 2026, Lupin announced that the acquisition of minority shareholding in Multicare Pharmaceuticals Philippines by its subsidiary Nanomi B.V. is expected to be completed in July 2026.
On May 29, 2026, Lupin announced US FDA approval for its generic Sodium Sulfate, Magnesium Sulfate, and Potassium Chloride Tablets with 180-day exclusivity.
Lupin and Natco received US FDA approval for generic Eribulin Mesylate Injection, targeting USD 43.7 million in annual U.S. sales.
On June 4, 2026, Lupin received U.S. FDA approval for its ranibizumab biosimilar, Ranluspec.
Lupin partnered with Spain's Laboratorios ERN to launch Luforbec pMDI (beclometasone/formoterol) for adult asthma and COPD in Spain.

Lupin's Q1FY27 call (7 Aug 2026) reported record revenue of ₹8,277 Cr and 30% EBITDA margin, but reiterated high single-digit FY27 growth and ~25% margin guidance as US Tolvaptan and Mirabegron competition steps up from Q2.
Lupin Limited’s earnings call for Q2 FY27 is scheduled for November 04, 2026, at 18:00 IST, hosted by AMIT KUMAR GUPTA (ACS -15754).
USFDA concluded an inspection at the Goa facility with one observation on October 23, 2026.
